How to Build a Website with Kinsta WordPress Hosting from Scratch?

 

Kinsta is a powerful WordPress hosting service that allows you to quickly and easily create a website. With Kinsta, you don’t need to be an expert coder or designer to get your website up and running.

All you need is a few clicks and some basic knowledge of WordPress.

In this section, I am sharing a Kinsta WordPress guide that will help you to set up a new website with Kinsta WordPress hosting.

So, without wasting any time, let’s start the process.

 

Sign Up with Kinsta

 

Step 01: Add a Domain Name

 

As Kinsta does not sell domains, you have to buy a domain name from a different hosting provider. Then, add that domain to your Kinsta site.

  1. First, go to the MyKinsta dashboard, then go to the site where you want to add the domain and click on “Domains.”
  2. There, you will find an “Add Domain” button under the Domain List; click that.
  3. Here, you can add your domain names if you are adding a new root domain. Then, assign a primary domain.
  4. If you are migrating to Kinsta, make sure you are picking the same version that you were using before.

 

Step 02: Purchase Hosting

 

This step is as easy as doing online shopping. Just follow the instructions, your hosting will be purchased within a few minutes.

  1. Go to the Kinsta website and click on the “View our pricing” button. View plans and choose a suitable one.
  2. Click the button “Choose” from the selected plan. Then you have to fill out a form, and with that it, your purchase will be made!

 

Step 03: Connect your Domain and Hosting Via DNS

 

  1. To connect your domain with hosting, you must pass a few steps. I am sharing the steps one by one so that you can get them clearly.
  2. Add your domain to Kinsta’s DNS in MyKinsta.
  3. Enter your domain in the Add domain modal/pop-up.
  4. Add the hosting address. After finishing entering the addresses, click the “done” button. Your hosting is now connected to your domain name.

Step 04: Add A New Site

 

  1. Go to my.kinsta.com to access your Kinsta Dashboard.
  2. You’ll notice a huge button that reads Add Your First Site Now if this is your first website. Alternatively, you can select Add New Site by clicking Sites in the left navigation. You can create a site using one of the two choices.
  3. You will then be prompted to select the data center you want to use for your website. Select the data center that is most convenient for most of your expected website visitors.
  4. Then, pick a memorable and appropriate site name. Pick a term that adequately represents your website. This should preferably sound a lot like the domain name you’re going to utilize.

So, these were the quick and easy steps of building a website.
